turns.speaker: Client
turns.text: I want to walk at lunch, but meetings get in the way.

turns.speaker: Clinician
turns.text: Walking matters to you, and protecting that time is difficult. What could help?

turns.speaker: Client
turns.text: I could block two lunch breaks on my calendar.

turns.speaker: Clinician
turns.text: You have found a practical starting point. It is your choice how to try it.
